title: Crate MITE
description: Added four types of Crates in 1.6.4-MITE, each with a 54-slot capacity.
body:
## Crate Mod
This mod adds four crates made of different materials.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6429a2b306918fca1c07ef6b7592e50fc1c91d6a.png)

Each crate has a 54-slot capacity.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27f37eb7324b184f6e1a5accac5a14bc8a4e140c.png)

Using 8 wood to craft 3 crates is a much better deal than the old 2-wood-to-1-chest recipe, plus they take up less space.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99085dadcca2e0a4ac35269e5ec7e5605583e940.png)
